atoms.statement: Accumulate frames in a list attribute on `_PendingVlmEvent` from trigger time until resolution, specifically appending `captured.image` on each loop iteration.
atoms.test: Assert `_PendingVlmEvent.frames` list is populated with `captured.image` on each loop iteration until resolution.

atoms.statement: Create `src/oko/live/video.py` with `encode_incident_video(frames, out_path, fps=10)` using `cv2.VideoWriter` and `fourcc mp4v`.
atoms.test: Unit test `encode_incident_video` with synthetic frames, verify it creates a valid MP4 file readable by `cv2.VideoCapture` and uses `fps=10` and `mp4v` codec.

atoms.statement: Upon pending event resolution, save the encoded video to `runs/incidents/<event_id>.mp4` and add the file path to `bridge_output['incident_video_path']`.
atoms.test: Integration test: after a delayed event resolves, verify `runs/incidents/<event_id>.mp4` exists and `bridge_output['incident_video_path']` is set to this path.

atoms.statement: Implement comprehensive pytest validation, including a unit test for the encoder (synthetic frames → encode → `cv2.VideoCapture` readback `>1` frame) and an integration test for the end-to-end flow (delayed event resolves → `bridge_output.incident_video_path` set → file exists → `cv2.VideoCapture` readback `>1` frame), both guarded by `pytest.importorskip('cv2')`.
atoms.test: Unit test: `encode_incident_video` with synthetic frames, verify it returns a path, and `cv2.VideoCapture` reads >1 frame. Integration test: delayed event resolves, `bridge_output.incident_video_path` set, file exists, `cv2.VideoCapture` reads >1 frame.

atoms.statement: Add `incident_video_path: str | None = None` as a real field on `BridgeOutput` to correctly carry the path under `extra='forbid'` policy.
atoms.test: Verify `BridgeOutput` can be serialized/deserialized with `incident_video_path` set, without `ValidationError` due to `extra='forbid'`.

atoms.statement: `encode_incident_video` returns `str|None` and acts as a graceful no-op (returns `None`, writes nothing) when `cv2`/`numpy` are unavailable, when there are `<1` usable `ndarray` frames, or when `VideoWriter` fails to open (`writer.isOpened()==False`).
atoms.test: Unit test `encode_incident_video` with empty frames, non-ndarray frames, or `cv2` unavailable, verify it returns `None` and no file is written.

atoms.statement: Wire video writing into the pending-resolve path only (`_resolve_pending_vlm_event` → `_resolve_vlm_event`), scoping Step 1 to deferred person/animal events.
atoms.test: Integration test: immediate (non-deferred) event does NOT produce an incident video.

atoms.statement: Add an injectable `incidents_dir: Path = Path('runs/incidents')` constructor parameter on `LivePipeline`; ensure `mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)` is called lazily before writing; filename is `<sanitized event_id>.mp4`.
atoms.test: Integration test: `LivePipeline` initialized with `tmp_path` for `incidents_dir`, verify MP4 is written to `tmp_path` and directory is created.
